content: Weekly Family Update – 02.10.26 Headteacher’s Update: Keeping You Informed About What Matters Most What a fantastic week it has been at Abbey College. I continue to be impressed by our students’ positive attitude, hard work and commitment to making a difference to both themselves and those around them. A particular highlight was our Year 6 Open Evening, where we welcomed over 300 families to the college. It was wonderful to see so many prospective students and parents exploring our school.
